damagephysics.configuration.title: DamagePhysics Configuration
Choose whether damage numbers render as 2D billboards in the 3D world originating from entities, or as fixed 2D HUD numbers on the screen.
damagephysics.configuration.see_through_: Whether world-space damage numbers are visible through solid blocks.
damagephysics.configuration.gravity.tool: Downward acceleration per tick applied to damage numbers.
damagephysics.configuration.air_drag.too: Air resistance multiplier per tick (e.g. 0.98 decelerates numbers smoothly).
damagephysics.configuration.spawn_impuls: Initial upward velocity impulse when a damage number spawns.
damagephysics.configuration.crit_multipl: Velocity multiplier applied to critical hit numbers.
damagephysics.configuration.lifetime.too: Duration in ticks that a damage number stays visible before fading out.
Maximum number of active damage numbers allowed on screen.
damagephysics.configuration.enable_colli: Allows damage numbers to collide and push each other apart.
damagephysics.configuration.enable_spark: Displays dynamic spark particles on critical hits.
Displays green healing numbers when an entity gains health.
damagephysics.configuration.crit_color.t: Hex color code for critical hit damage numbers (default: #FFAA00).
damagephysics.configuration.normal_color: Hex color code for normal damage numbers (default: #FFFFFF).
damagephysics.configuration.heal_color.t: Hex color code for healing numbers (default: #55FF55).
damagephysics.configuration.min_font_sca: Font scale for small damage hits.
damagephysics.configuration.max_font_sca: Font scale for maximum/critical damage hits.
damagephysics.configuration.ref_damage.t: Damage amount that maps to maximum font scale.
